summary: QIAGEN N.V., a Dutch foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report and includes only standard discussions of non-GAAP financial measures, free cash flow, and constant currency metrics. No special-situation transaction, corporate action, or management change is disclosed. The filing is purely informational and does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, capital return, or strategic review. There is no deal structure, premium, or advisor information to analyze.
